testcase.system-out: Scenario: Click a folder highlighted by keyboard navigation ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the template chooser shows the metric folder and its grouped templates ✔ And the details pane identifies the selected Standard (mm) part template ✔ When the user clicks Metric in the folder tree and presses Up ✔ Then English is highlighted in the tree ✔ And the metric gallery and Standard (mm) details remain visible ✔ When the user clicks the highlighted English folder ✔ Then the gallery displays the English folder templates ✔ And the details pane still identifies Standard (mm) with millimeter units ✔ When the user cancels the chooser ✔ Then the original part remains active
